summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Event Detail Module - Overview Tab. All backend APIs (6 endpoints) and frontend components working correctly. Row click navigation from Events list to Event Detail page functional.
critical_code_review_comments: All Overview tab APIs are read-only and properly implemented with error handling
Frontend correctly fetches and displays data from all 6 overview endpoints
Period selector properly filters metrics and funnel data
Ticket status badges correctly show Selling Fast/Available/Sold Out based on inventory
seed_data_creation: Test data exists for event ID 1 (Tech Summit 2024) with registrations, tickets, analytics, refunds, and activity logs
context_for_next_testing_agent: Event Overview module fully functional. All 6 overview APIs tested: /api/events/:id, /api/events/:id/overview/metrics, /api/events/:id/overview/funnel, /api/events/:id/overview/tickets, /api/events/:id/overview/alerts, /api/events/:id/overview/activity. Frontend displays all components correctly with proper loading states.

row_click_navigation.details: Clicking event row in Events table navigates to /events/:id

event_detail_page_load.details: Event Detail page loads correctly with event data (name, date, status)

overview_tab_default.details: Overview tab is selected by default when navigating to Event Detail

kpi_metrics.details: 4 KPI cards display: Total Registrations (3), Gross Revenue ($547), Page Views (3), Conversion Rate (100%)

registration_funnel.details: Funnel shows Page Views → Add to Cart → Checkout Started → Completed Registration with percentages

period_selector.details: Period selector works with Last 7 Days, Last 30 Days, All Time options

ticket_inventory_health.details: Shows 3 tickets: Early Bird (Selling Fast), General Admission (Available), VIP Access (Sold Out)

attention_needed_alerts.details: Shows 1 pending refund request alert with error styling

recent_internal_activity.details: Shows activity timeline with system and admin actions

event_timeline.details: Shows 4 timeline items: Registration Completed, Ticket Price Updated, Ticket Sold Out, Event Published

breadcrumb_navigation.details: Events breadcrumb navigates back to Events list

api_get_event_by_id.details: GET /api/events/:eventId returns event details with all fields

api_overview_metrics.details: GET /api/events/:eventId/overview/metrics returns totalRegistrations, grossRevenue, pageViews, conversionRate with changes

api_registration_funnel.details: GET /api/events/:eventId/overview/funnel returns pageViews, addToCart, checkoutStarted, completedRegistration

api_ticket_inventory.details: GET /api/events/:eventId/overview/tickets returns ticket list with id, name, sold, total, status

api_attention_alerts.details: GET /api/events/:eventId/overview/alerts returns alerts with type, text, category

api_activity_timeline.details: GET /api/events/:eventId/overview/activity returns activity logs with actorType, actionType, description, createdAt
